topic: Timestep-invariant analytical spring damper versus explicit Euler frame drops
topic_zh: 时间步长无关解析弹簧跟随与显式欧拉掉帧过冲对比
scope: Deterministic closed-form critically damped second-order ODE semigroup update, explicit Euler divergence audit and Node CPU solving. No Spring-Gaus neural 3DGS training or nonlinear continuum FEM.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. Closed-form matrix exponential versus 64-substep 4th-order Runge-Kutta integration, not neural physics or GPU rendering.

protocol.function: state (e_0, v_0) → matrix exponential exp(A·Δt) → semigroup step invariance → 0 overshoot & 0 drift

robustness.name: Sampled spring states retain zero frame-drop drift under reverse visitation

good_fit: Frame-rate-independent camera and UI spring follow-through
Surviving 80ms+ browser tab hitching without overshoot
not_for: Nonlinear contact and self-collision cloth solvers
Plastic fracture or tearing continuum mechanics
